## Goal

Only capability holders can use an artifact: the gateway, addressing and sessions implement the whole hygiene checklist and serve published versions with no process.

## Owned requirements

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

| ID | Requirement | Route | Concrete check |
|---|---|---|---|
| HY-01 | **Invariant.** Only capability-URL holders can use an artifact; the 13-point checklist in ARCHITECTURE §11 is implemented in full | M, I (negative tests: bad Host, bad Origin, missing token, CSRF) | All 13 checklist items as automated negative tests (bad Host, bad Origin, missing token, CSRF, CORS, CORP, referrer, revocation 410, rate limit, redaction, GET side effects, header fuzzing, MCP HTTP) |
| HY-02 | Loopback is the default bind; wider binds need an explicit flag | I | Default bind is loopback only (socket inspection); wider bind needs the flag |
| HY-03 | Tokens are scoped (view, draft, submit, `action:<name>`, review), expire, rotate and revoke | M, I | Scoped tokens: a view-and-comment link cannot submit or run an action; expiry, rotation and revocation tests |
| SH-01 | **Invariant.** The shell runs on its own origin; trusted controls never render in an origin agent code controls | B | Shell and artifact are different origins; trusted controls exist only in the shell DOM (browser assertion) |
| SH-03 | **Default.** The shell and each artifact have their own origins on one loopback hostname with stably leased ports and origin-bound Strict sessions (cookie mode); cross-site deliveries use worker-mode frame sessions | B | Cookie mode in Chromium, Firefox, WebKit and real Safari; leases stable across restart; cross-site fixtures select worker mode |
| SH-04 | Shell and artifact talk over a validated JSON-RPC `postMessage` bridge shaped like MCP Apps | M, B | Bridge rejects wrong origin and malformed messages (unit); message names match MCP Apps where shared |
| RT-05 | Frozen client-only versions are served with no worker process | I | Client-only version served with zero worker processes (process table assertion) |
| VR-03 | **Invariant.** Viewers only open published versions; no human path uses hot reload | B | No viewer URL reaches dev or unpublished content (route enumeration test); viewers only open versions |
| LL-05 | Local capability URLs don't expire by default and stay revocable and rotatable; `mostra doctor` warns when long-lived artifacts exist without an always-on daemon | I | Local URL works after a week of simulated time; revocation and rotation work; doctor warns about long-lived artifacts without an always-on daemon |

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- the Hono gateway in the supervisor;
- leased ports for the shell and artifacts;
- capability tokens with scopes, expiry, rotation and revocation;
- cookie-mode sessions with frame tickets, CSRF and exact Host and Origin checks;
- static serving of versions with no process;
- the minimal shell app hosting the iframe;
- the validated bridge transport;
- `view/url` and `view/revoke`;
- non-expiring local URLs.

Design detail for this package:

- Leased ports per home; shell port plus one per opened artifact; reuse across restarts.
- Token: 128+ bits CSPRNG, stored hashed, scopes, expiry optional, rotation, revocation (410).
- Cookie mode: exchange token for an origin-bound `HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict` session; shell hands the frame a single-use ticket; strip tokens from URLs with redirects and `history.replaceState`.
- Exact Host allowlist, exact Origin on non-GET, streams and upgrades, CSRF header plus JSON content type, CORP, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, rate limit on token paths, redaction in logs.
- Static serving of version files; minimal shell app with the iframe and the validated bridge transport (message set grows in WP-07 and WP-20).
- Strip Mostra cookies before any proxying (used from WP-08 on).

## Out of scope

- Worker mode (WP-13)
- Trusted controls and banner (WP-07)
- Review overlay (WP-20)

## Acceptance evidence

- the full 13-point checklist as automated negative tests in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit (bad Host, bad Origin, missing token, missing CSRF, revoked token gives 410, rate limit);
- the session survives a restart;
- a client-only version is served with zero workers;
- no viewer path reaches `mostra dev` or unpublished source;
- real Safari smoke run (macOS).

Also: `pnpm check` green (from WP-01 on), diff reviewed, evidence matrix rows updated, docs and AGENTS.md current, progress report written after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- WebKit drops `Secure` cookies over HTTP localhost (prototype): never set `Secure` on loopback HTTP.

## Handoff

Viewers can open versions safely; later packages add endpoints behind the same checks.
